description: What we ask Jev about every inbound support email. Add a question here and it becomes a user.jev.<name> attribute that flags can target.

urgent.instructions: Does this email need a human reply today? The customer's plan is in the state.

criteria.true: Outage, money at risk, or an explicit deadline.
criteria.false: FYI, general question, or it can wait until tomorrow.

frustration.instructions: How frustrated is the customer who wrote this email?
